newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NZ Oil & Gas awarded Maui West permit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NZ Oil & Gas awarded Maui West permit.

text.p: New Zealand Oil and Gas Ltd said on Tuesday it had been granted a permit to explore for oil over a 5,500 square km area west of the Maui oil and gas field off the western coast of New Zealand's North Island.

"The potential of this area is highlighted by the discovery during development drilling in the Maui B Field of a deeper oil pool which reportedly will produce up to 30,000 barrels of oil a day when fully commissioned during the next month," NZOG said in a statement released to the Australian stock exchange.
"This oil may have been generated from the west of the field, where a number of potentially very large structures have been identified by NZOG within its new licence," it said.
"Acquisition of this licence represents a shift of exploration emphasis for NZOG, by targeting offshore acrerage with prospects of very high potential."
NZOG's shares were unchanged at 37 New Zealand cents at 11.50 pm (0150 GMT).
